question: Adapt the generic Z180 matched-pair fixture to catalog H-40-12 dimensions and current tolerances, retaining the original error conditions and reporting unmet allowances without a tool or physical-use pass. Compare the documented FISCH wood bit and distinguish full-guide and lower chip routes.

changes.effective_guidance_scope: A condition on contiguous cylindrical guidance contained entirely in the underhead body, without assuming head or entrance radius guides. This 18-mm minimum is not established by the catalog or by physical observation.
changes.catalog_dimension_tolerance_scope: Use current manufacturer unlisted +/-0.015-inch dimensions for underhead length, head F and head G. Do not import the older +/-0.010-inch statement or infer a measured part.
changes.retainer_spacer_scope: Set guide-only cap spacers to the actual head top, within the proposed 0..0.05-mm capture gap. A fixed nominal spacer is not guaranteed to accommodate the catalog head-height range. No frame packing or permanent fastener changes.

configured_ID_scope: The exact four-decimal ordering suffix is not selected. Show both surrounding four-decimal values and exact fractional 13/32 as separate diameter comparisons; the fraction is not a four-decimal order instruction.
limits: Only temporary fixture dimensions change. Current Z200 frame, four HOLD stations, 100 bolts, 66 Hillman,old fields and both handed mappings remain unchanged; Z180 is unadopted.
All full-path error allocations remain declared design conditions. Any exceeded generic allowance is retained as an unmet comparison. No machining accuracy or complete fixture pass.
The general manufacturer 0.5..1.5D chip-gap guidance is a comparison, not a mandatory wood-specific minimum, chip-removal proof or guided handheld drilling qualification.

Permanent press-fit H bushings and recommended metal jig holes do not qualify a wood receiving plate. Guide material, mounting retention, fit, entrance geometry and achievable accuracy remain actual inputs.

Catalog dimensions/working length do not establish usable chuck projection, usable guided flute, point length, runout, chip behavior or physical tool access. A full-guide route shortfall alone does not reject a bit when a separately justified lower outlet exists.
FISCH NL 120 and GL 150 are manufacturer nominal dimensions, with no published tolerance in the cited page. No part, purchase, bit or physical operation is selected.
No physical test, floor-friction test, CAD, BREP query, native mechanics, source forces, model edit, staging or commit.
